item.tib: dbal gsas drag po sbyin bsreg
item.coloph: smon rgyal bla ma g.yung drung phun tshogs kyi phyag dpe kyi bu yig la zhal pas lags so / bkra shis so
item.note: the colophon tells us that the manuscript represented here was copied from a copy of the personal manuscript of smon-rgyal bla-ma g.yung-drung phun-tshogs (a smon-rgyal g.yung-drung phun-tshogs precedes kun-grol grags-pa, b. 1700, in a lineage in brgyud rim, p. 158).
